svg.title: From the mechanism to the requirements
svg.desc: A selective overview of conditional contributions to T1–T4, timing, selected requirement families and H1–H6. It makes no conformance or measurement claim.
svg.text: From the mechanism to the requirements
Plausible contributions, with their remaining obligations.
The strongest direct support concerns bounded parts of T1 and T2.
T1 · MATERIAL AWARENESS
Within a declared boundary
Scope-aligned metadata may expose an expired
assumption, incompatible basis or lost assessment
capability concealed by operative outputs.
Still needed: a material target, detectable change
family, justified interpretation and explicit blind spots.
T2 · QUALIFIED DETERMINATION
Owner-preserving handoff
Preserve grounds and unresolved alternatives; support
a posture to continue, requalify, contain/hold, escalate
or preserve UNKNOWN.
Still needed: current owner, dependencies,
authority/capacity limits, expiry, re-entry and valid
sources for the handoff.
T3 · BOUNDED AND AUTHORIZED
Response remains a coupled obligation
The mechanism can identify a limit, preserve
authorization needs and support a bounded candidate
position.
Still needed: legitimate owner, permitted actions,
reversibility and downside conditions—including the
per-state no-worse-than-null-action guarantee.
Metadata alone cannot establish these.
T4 · TIMELY AND VIABLE
Minimum-sufficient requalification
Targeted summaries make bounded effort conceivable
without reconstructing every source state.
Still needed: total costs, response margins, useful
stopping rules and resilience to saturation and
oscillation. Communication savings alone do not
establish viability.
An illustrative sufficient timing condition — serial case
t_available + τ_qualification + τ_response < t_last useful response
Concurrent paths need their actual elapsed-time bound. Qualification must remain applicable when the response acts.
Selected routes into the requirements
S3 / S10: review changed applicability and commitments; cancellation or new authority is not supplied by the
indication.
S5 / S14: preserve indeterminacy; UNKNOWN is not automatic global containment.
S9 / S11: preserve qualified scopes and dependencies; different reports need not be independent.
These are selected routes. The remaining requirement families and full boundaries are in 00N §3.4.
The existing six hypotheses remain distinct
H1 preserves insufficient determination within window U. H2 separates confidence conditional on U from the
open residual beyond it.
H3 concerns hidden qualifications and false confidence under composition. H4 asks whether enough context
can be preserved without full-state disclosure.
H5 concerns freshness and dependency churn. H6 concerns the risk/resource trade-off of window selection.
No additional hypothesis family. No measurements or requirement fulfillment are claimed.
Selective overview · 00N v0.7, §§3.2–3.5 · Full S/T/H routes, authority conditions and KPIs remain in the note.
